stock.description: As an investment holding company, Modern Chinese Medicine Group Co., Ltd. manufactures and distributes traditional Chinese pharmaceutical products, primarily targeting the middle-aged and elderly populations across the People's Republic of China. Its extensive product line provides treatments for a wide array of health issues, including qi deficiency, blood stasis, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular conditions, digestive and gastrointestinal ailments, gynecological problems, as well as disorders affecting the respiratory and nervous systems. Established in 1986, the enterprise maintains its principal offices in Chengde, China, and operates as a subsidiary of Modern Biotechnology Group Holdings Co., Ltd.
